uiHints.unlock.opensWhen.deeds: Opens after you earn an achievement.

uiHints.group.full: This group has no room for another cat.
uiHints.unlock.opensWhen.askjoin: Opens once you've met this pride's leader. Stand on their land to ask.
uiHints.ui.action.rest.line: Rest the day away and get your Energy back.
uiHints.ui.action.watch.line: See which cats pass this ground, and what they're doing.
uiHints.ui.action.scent.line: See who has been on this ground.
uiHints.ui.action.spar.line: Wrestle with a cat who knows you well.
uiHints.ui.action.askjoin.line: Ask this pride to take you in.
uiHints.ui.action.patrol.line: Walk your borders and watch for trouble.
uiHints.ui.action.mark.line: Leave your scent so others know this land is held.

required.identity: Actual current saved id, generated name and portrait; no fixed name/roster-lean personality. Every active NPC speaker uses their own saved traits.

personalityContract.bands: low <=30, high >=70, otherwise baseline. Missing any required trait is an explicit unresolved speaker-data state, never a generic successful personality pass.

speechCoverage.baseline: You again. Are you stopping, or just passing?
speechCoverage.high: You came back! Will you stay a while?

speechCoverage.low: Oh, it's you. I know your scent by now.
speechCoverage.baseline: I knew it was you before I saw you. Your scent's getting familiar.
speechCoverage.high: I knew that was you! I've started looking out for your tracks, you know.

byCat.bf01: You again. Most strays learn to keep off my field. You're still here.
byCat.bf02: It's you. I'm glad. Don't tell the others I said that.
byCat.bf03: I knew it was you. Still on hares? We'll fix that yet.
byCat.bf04: You're back. You can stay, as long as you keep clear of the cubs' hollow.
byCat.bf05: I heard you coming, but only just. You're getting quieter.
byCat.bf06: I knew your step before I saw you. Nobody else walks quite like that.
byCat.bf07: Ah, it's you. I was hoping somebody would come and talk to an old cat.
byCat.hc01: I knew that scent was yours. You've kept to our law, so I've time for you.
byCat.hc02: Oh, it's you. Good. You're the only cat who doesn't tell me how my mother would do it.
byCat.hc03: Thought it was you. You've learned to come in downwind. That's something.
byCat.hc04: It's you. I was hoping it would be. Want to walk somewhere that isn't the caves?
byCat.hc05: I picked out your tracks this morning. I'd know them anywhere now.
byCat.hc06: Hello, you. The cubs are asleep, so I've a little while.
byCat.hc07: I smelled you at the border and didn't stop you. Don't make me sorry.
byCat.hc08: I've been saying your name with the others, so I don't lose it. Come and talk.
byCat.ln01: It's you. I like knowing somebody will come by.
byCat.ln02: Oh, it's only you. I mean, I'm glad it's you.
byCat.ln03: I smelled you coming. You've been near Bonefield again, haven't you?
byCat.ln04: Just you? Good. I don't mind you around.
byCat.ln05: You're still in the Vale! I was sure you'd have gone north by now.
byCat.ln06: There you are, dear. I'd started to worry.
byCat.ln07: You keep coming back. I've stopped asking why.
byCat.ln08: It's you. I hoped you'd come along the river again.
byCat.ln09: It's you. You're about the only familiar scent I've got out here.
byCat.mw01: I know your voice in the fog now. That's more than I can say for most.
byCat.mw02: It's you. All right. I can stop keeping watch for a bit.
byCat.mw03: There you are. I've walked further than you today, I bet.
byCat.mw04: I tracked you most of the way here. Don't worry, it's a compliment.
byCat.mw05: Oh, it's you. You stepped on the safe stones without me telling you. Good.
byCat.mw06: You came back! I've been telling everybody about you.
byCat.mw07: I'd know that scent anywhere now, young cat. Come and sit.

speechCoverage.low: You could stay a while. If you want to, I mean.
speechCoverage.baseline: There you are. Will you stay a while?
speechCoverage.high: Stay with me a while. I've been hoping you'd come by.

byCat.bf01: You. Sit. I don't say this to anybody, but I'm glad you came.
byCat.bf02: I've stopped going down to the ford. I come here instead. Will you stay?
byCat.bf03: Forget the hunt for a bit. Will you stay with me?
byCat.bf04: Come and sit. The cubs can tumble about without me for a while.
byCat.bf05: No fuss today. Just stay a while, will you?
byCat.bf06: I've been saving things I noticed, just to tell you. Will you stay?
byCat.bf07: Stay a while. It's good not to be alone with my thoughts.
byCat.hc01: There you are. The crag can manage without me for a while. Will you stay?
byCat.hc02: You came. I don't have to prove anything to you, do I? Stay a bit.
byCat.hc03: I kept the good spot on the rock for you. Will you stay?
byCat.hc04: I'm glad it's you. With you I don't feel out of place. Stay?
byCat.hc05: I left the hare tracks for later. I'd rather sit with you. Will you stay?
byCat.hc06: The cubs are asleep, and I'd like some company. Stay with me?
byCat.hc07: I don't let many cats this close. Will you stay a while?
byCat.hc08: Sit with me. I'll never let your name slip now.
byCat.ln01: You came back again. Sit with me a while, will you?
byCat.ln02: I didn't sit at the Split Rock today. I came looking for you. Will you stay?
byCat.ln03: You're the only cat I don't want something from. Stay a while?
byCat.ln04: I don't need to check behind you any more. Will you stay?
byCat.ln05: Right now I don't want to be anywhere else. Will you stay?
byCat.ln06: Come and sit, dear. I've been saving my warm spot for you.
byCat.ln07: You know what I did, and you still come. Will you stay a while?
byCat.ln08: I stopped looking at the water for a bit when I saw you. Will you stay?
byCat.ln09: I don't think about the fog so much when you're here. Stay?
byCat.mw01: I can put the pride down for a moment when you're here. Will you stay?
byCat.mw02: When you're here I can stop watching the trees. Will you stay a while?
byCat.mw03: I don't mind resting when it's with you. Stay?
byCat.mw04: I don't trust many cats, but I trust you. Will you stay?
byCat.mw05: I walked the old trail and thought about showing it to you. Stay with me a while?
byCat.mw06: It doesn't feel so quiet when you're here. Will you stay?
byCat.mw07: Sit by me, young cat. I'm always glad when it's your scent on the path.

speechCoverage.high: Yes! I was hoping you'd ask me that.

speechCoverage.low: Not yet. I'm sorry. I'm just not ready to say yes.
speechCoverage.baseline: Not now. I'm not ready to say yes.
speechCoverage.high: No. Not now, and don't push me on it.

speechCoverage.low: No. I don't feel that way about you.
speechCoverage.baseline: I'm sorry. I don't feel that way about you.
speechCoverage.high: I like you, I really do. Just not like that. We can still talk, though.

speechCoverage.baseline: What are you asking of the pride?
speechCoverage.high: You've come to me together. What is it you want?

speechCoverage.low: All right. The pride accepts it.
speechCoverage.baseline: Yes. The pride will accept you as mates.
speechCoverage.high: Yes. You have the pride's blessing, both of you.

speechCoverage.low: I'm sorry. I can't give you that this season.
speechCoverage.baseline: No. Not this season, so don't ask me again.
speechCoverage.high: No. And don't ask me again this season.

speechCoverage.low: I'm sorry, but I'm courting {catName} too. I have to challenge you.
speechCoverage.baseline: You're courting {catName}? So am I. Let's settle this.
speechCoverage.high: You think you can court {catName}? Prove it. Come on.

speechCoverage.low: All right, you win. It's still up to {catName}, though.
speechCoverage.baseline: Fine. You won. But {catName} still gets to choose.
speechCoverage.high: Fine, you won fair. {catName} still chooses, not you.

speechCoverage.low: So we're mates now. I'm choosing this, you know.
speechCoverage.baseline: So we're mates now. You and me.
speechCoverage.high: Mates, then. I'm staying right beside you.

speechCoverage.baseline: Our own pride. {newPrideName}. I like the sound of that.
speechCoverage.high: {newPrideName}. Our own pride! I want to see every bit of this place.

speechCoverage.low: What do you want with us?
speechCoverage.baseline: You're on our trail. What do you want?
speechCoverage.high: Where have you come from? I'd like to hear.

speechCoverage.low: Fine. You can come with us.
speechCoverage.baseline: Come with us, then. We're moving on.
speechCoverage.high: Come with us! It'll be nice to have someone new.

speechCoverage.low: Sorry. We can't take you with us.
speechCoverage.baseline: No. We're not taking you with us.
speechCoverage.high: No. Go find your own way.

speechCoverage.low: All right. You can stay with us.
speechCoverage.baseline: You can stay. Come on, walk with us.
speechCoverage.high: You're with us now. Welcome to {originPrideName}.

speechCoverage.low: I'm sorry. There's no place for you here right now.
speechCoverage.baseline: No. There's no place for you here.

aggression.low: {catName} keeps the words soft and gentle.
aggression.high: {catName} says it through a tight jaw.

devNote.high: Jaw tightens briefly; does not invent a strike or threat outcome.

sociability.low: {catName} keeps a little distance between you.
sociability.high: {catName} comes right up close to talk.

boldness.high: {catName} stands square in front of you.

loyalty.low: {catName} keeps glancing off toward the open land.
loyalty.middle: {catName} stays to hear what you say.
loyalty.high: {catName} keeps an ear turned toward home.

devNote.low: Does not close the listener’s route away.
devNote.high: Remains beside the person or place of the actual chosen commitment; no sworn promise or loyalty fact invented.

curiosity.high: {catName}'s head tilts, ears pricked, full of questions.

devNote.high: Pauses to study the listener before answering; no mind reading or hidden-history inference.

personalityContract.application: At every NPC speech and visible reaction, select saved focus-trait line plus concise context-compatible cues drawn from all five traits. All-five rendering follows installed revision6 personality contract; do not stack five canned action sentences. Affinity/actual knowledge modulate distance and recalled cause, never overwrite traits. Outcome chosen only by engine. Player lines/choices are intentions, not NPC-generated personality.
personalityContract.precedence: Installed recurring conversation revision6 retains its exact pending lines/actions/receipts. This coverage is for stage-specific new scenes or explicit fallback only. A newly numeric stage never silently replaces a pending conversation. Archived voiceVariants do not execute.
personalityContract.noUnchosenContact: No default cheek/nose/coat contact or grooming from numeric affinity alone. Offer appropriate player intent under actual eligibility; do not force the player’s feelings or a hidden promise.
personalityContract.persist: Save actual NPC identity, trait snapshot/version, selected speechId/band/action, node and offered choices. Continue displays same line, not a rerolled personality.

runtimeContract.authority: Semantic authoring schema only; Flint maps IDs/results to real engine APIs. Tundra spec and formulas own numerical gates/costs/rolls. No invented balance adjustment to force a successful run.
runtimeContract.bond: Met→acquainted≥15→close≥25 require actual chosen beats. Court requires close beat, adult/elder, attraction, kin and unpaired gates, correct window/cadence. A numeric value alone grants neither consent, crush nor mates. Accepted courtship expresses willingness only until all stable-bond/pride approval/rival conditions commit.
runtimeContract.prideOrigin: Leader approval type(a) and actual qualifying non-lethal rival required only where specified. Approval never transfers ownership of a cat, substitutes consent, sets a feud ruling or automatically teaches an absent leader.
runtimeContract.commit: At mate confirmation, actual reciprocal mate IDs/stage and mate_secured milestone commit once. Found commits actual legal region, pride/den/claim/membership once; pending acknowledgement never replicates +20 origin standing or source receipts.
runtimeContract.costs: Use current spec §3 actions, gate checks and originating-day budget exactly. Court meeting choice consumes no second day; Court-as-action Energy -5. Seek out same home zone -5 or legal one-day Travel -15; no same-day hunt. Found after day20 legal with existing mate; illegal Found and forced out-of-window Court reject atomically. Preserve affordable/free exits and earlier resource fixes.
runtimeContract.continuation: mate_secured and pride_founded are NONTERMINAL. Season_end occurs once after day20 chains resolve/lapse, then day21 actions continue. Mated results Continue only; unmated-without-pride three route-intent buttons each continue without locking route, charging a day, granting membership or creating groups. No new-run ending, time skip, year length, later season name or breeding.
runtimeContract.knowledge: Use actual participants/witnesses and explicit relays. Stage/proximity/affinity is not knowledge of a specific quiet walk, kill, promise, political dispute or approval. Never narrate leader knowledge from pride standing alone.
runtimeContract.day20: Resolve existing same-day chain or lapse per spec §4; no pending court/approval/rival rolls survive as a fresh day21 mate bond. Existing mate may Found later. Dead mate stays dead; historical milestone is not live mate state.
runtimeContract.save: Persist full stage, gates, attempt/cooldown receipts, chosen variants, cast/knowledge, reciprocal bond, origin membership, founding record, seasonEndShown and routeIntent. Save/Continue before/after each commit cannot reroll, redeliver, duplicate reward, lose a Continue button or resurrect a completed chain.
runtimeContract.groups: route_group intent promises no immediate group. Actual eligible saved group capacity/relationships/roll/membership remain required; mixed-sex eligibility is proposed per spec, not approved by narrative.
runtimeContract.allModes: Offline authored beats and online/local narration share exact state, eligibility, consent, knowledge and outcome constraints; no generated mechanics or free-text unlock implied.

implementationMilestones.deliverable: Ordinary loner path: met→chosen acquainted→chosen close→eligible Court→actual mutual/stable mates, with refused/ineligible branches and save persistence. Keep existing remembered conversations intact.
implementationMilestones.acceptance: No forced success, injected affinity, free greetings, new arbitrary threshold or generic missing traits. All actual five-trait speakers and exact pending scenes survive reload.

implementationMilestones.deliverable: Wild-land Found from committed mates, named pride/claim60/den/mate membership, nonterminal continuation. Pride-origin optional harder path uses actual approval/rival and proposed departure at Found.
implementationMilestones.acceptance: Ordinary paired/founded path, no double +20, no dual memberships, reject held/disputed Found with no cost, no breeding.

implementationMilestones.deliverable: Day20 nonterminal season_end for mated founded, mated unfounded and unmated; day21 survival and bonds persist; old day20-only ending reopened, actual death stays final.
implementationMilestones.acceptance: No skip/new year; mated on day20 can Found day22; unmated route intents do not fake membership; forced Court day21 has no state mutation.

edgeCaseForDesign.case: Mate dies before day20 while player already owns a pride: spec §4.6 preserves pride but three named season_end variants omit this combination.
edgeCaseForDesign.proposedSafeCopy: The mating season has ended. {newPrideName} remains your pride. Your mate is no longer beside you, but another day begins.
edgeCaseForDesign.proposedUI: Continue only; no living mate staging or automatic route switch. Uses existing continue result, no new mechanic.
edgeCaseForDesign.status: Nonblocking copy fallback PROPOSED for Tundra confirmation; do not use mated_founded with a dead mate.

validation.coverage: All actual B/C line locations mapped; source archives excluded
